# Accessibility

Follow [the accessibility guide](../../.agents/docs/accessibility.md) and [accessibility skill](../../.agents/skills/accessibility/SKILL.md).
Use native controls and landmarks, localized names and descriptions, visible focus, predictable route and overlay focus, and reduced-motion behavior.
Check keyboard, touch, zoom and screen reader journeys in all three locales.
Ask before a substantial color palette change.
